name: @lovenndme/dsh-skill-panel
description: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: lists global and per-project skills, enables or disables model and slash-command invocation, previews and edits SKILL.md, and creates, imports or deletes skills.
author: Lovenndme

compatibility.note: Host half registers its own HTTP routes under /api/dsh-skill-panel/* behind the Connection trust fence, and reads skill load state through agentPresets.acquireScope + skills.snapshot({ scope }) because the filesystem provider lives in preset scope on 0.2.x. Client half uses the settings.section slot. Skill roots and the frontmatter contract mirror @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem.
